title: The Russian Revolution - OverSimplified (Part 1)
beats: Jimmy tours France, Britain, Germany then Russia: modernizing Europe as baseline, Russia as stuck contrast
State problem: backward Russia, tsars refuse to modernize
Alexander II frees serfs with 49-year payment catch
Viewer would think Alexander II was loved; he is bombed
Nicholas weak, unprepared; his own admission he is not ready
Khodynka stampede and partying; image tarnished
Pivot to Lenin; Marx manifesto as needed prior
Bolshevik/Menshevik split via cereal-is-soup vote; names mean majority/minority and flip
Witte industrializes; workers get terrible conditions
Tsar picks war with Japan; defeat
October Manifesto splits opponents; Tsar reneges
Lenin learns from failure; Tsar learns nothing
Peace and recovery, then WWI cliffhanger
